title: Get sandy and wet with Fish’nCrab
author: jildos_legoplanet
selftext:
I’ve just launched an early playable demo of my latest project on Itch: [Fish’nCrab](https://sidesliders.itch.io/fishncrab).

The end dream is a cosy puzzle game full of physics puzzles through single-player co-op (or multiplayer, who knows) on a tropical island surrounded by vibrant corals full of sea life.

I dropped this demo early so I can get your feedback to shape the end game. Should I carry on with this?

I used a multi agent workflow in Claude with Blender MCP for the modeling and ElevenLabs for the audio to come to this ThreeJS web demo.
